Required-slots #3002 round 4 scoped source review against 2dc324b8a08..261f0cbf596: traced HomeView selection and Close continuation/Settings, ChatWorkspacePane and real Chat Close, RequiredSlotHost boundary catches, and requiredSlotRecovery host-document pruning. Removed the one-second reset and unreachable load-failed UI copy. Count is per slot/occurrence, emits exactly at catch three, persists through healthy renders/time/conversation changes, and ends with occurrence/scope lifetime. Standalone frame history ends at frame unmount. False availability requires an explicit selection-refused reason in the union. Only Home computes that state; Chat mounts directly. Canonical guide/design now state Chat-specific Close remount counting; module map/generated MCP now name the reachable selection diagnostic. Executed 75 owning tests, 9 deliberate source/type faults with byte-exact restoration and green reruns, and a fresh isolated Chrome selection-failure capture with Close to Settings. Those diagnostics grant no recovery authority. No live module loader, provider, native, hosted CI, release or production qualification is claimed. Review covers only this delta, preserving all earlier limits.
